A '''steel dolabra''' is a [[dolabra]] of the [[Steel equipment|steel]] tier, made by smithing an [[iron axe]] (or [[iron dolabra]]) with [[steel alloy]] and a [[smithing upgrade template]].

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

This upgrade needs a [[smithing upgrade template]] in the template slot; without one, the same iron axe and alloy make a [[steel axe]]. Enchantments on the base item carry over.

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
It breaks pickaxe and axe blocks at speed {{Value|Steel Dolabra|miningspeed}}, including obsidian, crying obsidian and ender chests, which it harvests with drops. It has {{Value|Steel Dolabra|durability}} durability.

Matcha Flavoured adds beds, candles, cacti and honeycomb blocks to the blocks that axes break quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Steel Dolabra|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Steel Dolabra|attackspeed}}.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
